approval.scope: 분리본 외형 확정, 가장자리·조립 교정과 기본 후면 적용/모션 연결

purpose: 수정된 외형의 후면 보트·탑승자 모션을 위한 분리 후보. 3D 모델이나 연속 회전 구현의 대체물이 아님.
tool: built-in image_gen; existing isolated Godot matte renderer
generation_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Image 1 is the approved design and exact appearance target, NOT loose inspiration. Prepare ONE coherent animation-cutout asset sheet derived from it, on genuine transparent background, landscape 1536x1024 or larger. Preserve the same painterly anime shading, rear elevated camera angle, weathered ivory wooden boat, dark tousled short hair, oversized pale blue hoodie, cream floppy-eared sleeping puppy, and cream cushion. No redesign, no oars, no new accessories. Sheet has three generously separated components, no text or borders: LEFT half contains the complete EMPTY boat with cushion and stern rail, seen from the exact same rear elevated angle as reference, bow up and stern down, reconstruct only interior obscured by occupants. TOP RIGHT contains the same reclining rear-facing child alone, complete visible head, blue hoodie torso, supported arms, forward directed legs, extracted without boat or dog, preserve relaxed supported pose and relative proportions; fill only tiny occluded areas needed for compositing, do not turn around. BOTTOM RIGHT contains the same sleeping cream puppy alone, full fluffy body, head and paws, identical viewing angle, pose and identity. All parts use matching source-scale ratios, identical lighting and original design, separate with large transparent padding, no overlap or background sea/sky. This is a technical candidate for independent secondary motion and assembly, not a new concept illustration. Do not draw checkerboard, ground shadows, UI, labels, captions, alternate poses, decorations, boats duplicated, or extra characters. True alpha transparency.
correction_prompt: Precise background-only technical edit of this exact asset sheet. Replace EVERY gray checkerboard background pixel with perfectly flat solid vivid magenta RGB(255,0,255), #FF00FF. No gradient, no shadow, no texture in background. Keep ALL three foreground components exactly unchanged in shape, pose, scale, location, colors, light and painting: left empty ivory wooden boat with cushion, upper-right rear-view blue-hoodie child, lower-right cream sleeping puppy. Do not move, redraw, add, crop or resize subjects. Remove checkerboard in all gaps and edges too. Same image dimensions and framing. No transparency requested this time: opaque uniform magenta key background for engine extraction. No text.
